# Toast: `jl-toast`

A short notification that something happened, with an optional action, that can close by itself.

- Class `JlToast`, a molecule: `import { JlToast } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/toast

A toast says something happened, without stopping anyone: saved, copied, failed, a new version. Most pages
never write one: they call toast() and the page's toaster stacks it in a corner (see Toaster). Write a jl-toast
yourself to show one in place, in a panel or in a preview.

With a duration it closes by itself; a thin line at the bottom shows the time left, and pauses while the pointer
or the focus is on the toast, so nobody loses a message while reading it. An action button (Undo, Retry, View)
emits action and closes the toast. Every way it closes ends with dismiss.

## Use

```ts
import { JlToast } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlToast
  actionLabel="Undo"
  closable
  heading="Changes saved"
  text="Your profile is up to date."
  tone="ok"
/>
```

```html
<jl-toast
  action-label="Undo"
  closable
  heading="Changes saved"
  text="Your profile is up to date."
  tone="ok"
></jl-toast>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `tone` (attribute `tone`): `'neutral' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'info'`, default `'neutral'`. The colour of the icon and of the time line.
- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The first line, in bold.
- `text` (attribute `text`): `string`, default `''`. The line under the heading.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon name; the tone's icon when empty.
- `closable` (attribute `closable`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows a close button.
- `actionLabel` (attribute `action-label`): `string`, default `''`. The text of a quiet button that emits action, then closes the toast.
- `duration` (attribute `duration`): `number`, default `0`. How long it stays, in milliseconds; 0 keeps it until it is closed. Hover and focus pause it.
- `working` (attribute `working`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows a progress bar under the text, while the work the toast tells about runs.
- `progress` (attribute `progress`): `number | null`, default `null`. How far that work is, in percent; without it, the bar runs back and forth.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `action` (`onAction` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The action button was pressed; the toast then closes.
- `dismiss` (`onDismiss` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The toast closed: its close button, its action, its time, or dismiss().

## Slots

- The default slot: More content under the text.

## Methods

- `dismiss(): void`: Closes the toast: it leaves, hides, then emits dismiss.
- `show(): void`: Shows a dismissed toast again, its time counted from the start.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The toast box.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Tones

The tone tints the toast, as it does jl-alert, and colours its time line; each tone has its own icon, filled in the tone's colour, unless one is given.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-toast heading="Link copied" text="Anyone with the link can view the board."></jl-toast>
  <jl-toast tone="ok" heading="Changes saved" text="Your profile is up to date."></jl-toast>
  <jl-toast tone="info" heading="Update available" text="Version 2.4 brings offline mode."></jl-toast>
  <jl-toast tone="warn" heading="Storage almost full" text="You have used 92% of 10 GB."></jl-toast>
  <jl-toast tone="danger" heading="Payment failed" text="The card was declined. Try another one."></jl-toast>
</div>
```

### With an action

An action and a close button. The action emits action, then the toast closes.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-toast class="undo" heading="Message archived" action-label="Undo" closable></jl-toast>
  <jl-toast tone="danger" icon="upload" heading="Upload failed" text="report-q3.pdf could not be sent." action-label="Retry" closable></jl-toast>
  <p class="muted undo-answer">Press Undo or close a toast.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const answer = root.querySelector('.undo-answer');
for (const toast of root.querySelectorAll('jl-toast')) {
  toast.events.register('action', () => (answer.textContent = `Action: ${toast.actionLabel.get()}`));
  toast.events.register('dismiss', () => (answer.textContent += ' (dismissed)'));
}
```

### Closing by itself

With a duration (here 6 seconds) it closes by itself; hover it to pause the line.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-toast class="timed" tone="ok" heading="Invite sent" text="ada@example.com can join in the next 7 days." duration="6000" closable></jl-toast>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button class="again" icon="refresh" label="Show it again"></jl-button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
const toast = root.querySelector('jl-toast.timed');
root.querySelector('.again').events.register('press', () => toast.show());
```

### Rich content

The default slot takes more than a line of text.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-toast tone="info" icon="users" heading="3 people joined Design review" closable>
    <p class="muted">Mila, Ben and Zoë accepted your invitation.</p>
  </jl-toast>
</div>
```
